dataset.description: Blind Claude-authored synthetic museum, observatory, and robotics-club memories; contains no user-derived data and was frozen before embedding evaluation.
dataset.distractor_policy: Each query preselects one accessible non-answer seven positions later in the same authored scope; shared queries use a same-domain shared distractor. Each also names one exact-scope-inaccessible control.

scope_of_claim: single synthetic retrieval corpus; heuristic product gate, not a universal benchmark
